formulationText: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - not a real product. Amoxicillin Trihydrate 10% w/w soluble powder. Each 1kg contains Amoxicillin Trihydrate 100g. For dissolving in drinking water.
aimOfUseHint: Treatment of bacterial infections in poultry caused by amoxicillin-sensitive organisms
directionOfUseHint: 1g per 10kg body weight in drinking water for 5 consecutive days
